about: Country cards for lives born in India. Each card is dealt only to them (and a little more often than general cards). Sources are in each card's "src".

events.src: ===================== India (IN) ===================== Coaching: in Kota, coaching and living cost about ₹1.5–3 lakh a year (Careers360; Lok Sabha answer: about ₹1.5 lakh plus ₹50,000 for a hostel). Two years ≈ ₹4 lakh ÷ the game's typical wage (₹92,000) ≈ 4: paid by the family (famCost).

en..x: The JEE and NEET entrance exams decide who gets into the top engineering and medical colleges. Many students spend two years at coaching institutes; in Kota, classes and a hostel cost about ₹1.5–3 lakh a year.
en..kota: Two years at a Kota institute
en..kota.s: Your family pays for classes and a hostel. Far from home and hard: Happiness −6.
en..no: Your family can’t pay for Kota.
en..self.s: Free online lessons and old papers.

zh..x: JEE和NEET入学考试决定谁能进顶尖的工程和医学院。很多学生花两年在补习机构；在科塔（Kota），补习加宿舍每年约15万到30万卢比。
zh..kota.s: 家里付补习费和宿舍费。离家远又辛苦：幸福感 −6。

zht..x: JEE和NEET入學考試決定誰能進頂尖的工程和醫學院。很多學生花兩年在補習機構；在科塔（Kota），補習加宿舍每年約15萬到30萬盧比。
zht..kota.s: 家裡付補習費和宿舍費。離家遠又辛苦：幸福感 −6。
zht..self.s: 免費線上課程加歷年考題。

events.src: PPF: 7.1% a year, tax-free, unchanged for Jul–Sep 2025; 15-year lock-in; up to ₹1.5 lakh a year (Ministry of Finance, via Business Standard and Motilal Oswal). With CPI near 4.5%, about 2.5% after inflation.

opts.do: yearly('ppf', { amt: a, until: age + 15 }, { rate: .025, lock: age + 15 }, 'trk.ppf')

en..x: The Public Provident Fund pays 7.1% a year, tax-free (the rate is set every quarter and was unchanged through 2025), but your money is locked for 15 years. An index-fund SIP rises and falls with the market.
en..ppf.s: About {a} a year for 15 years. About 2.5% a year after inflation, guaranteed.
en..sip.s: About {a} a year for 15 years. About 5% a year after inflation on average, with crashes along the way.

zh..x: 公共公积金（PPF）年利率7.1%，免税（利率每季调整，2025年都没变），但钱要锁15年。指数基金定投（SIP）则随市场涨跌。
zh..ppf.s: 每年约{a}，存15年。扣除通胀后每年约2.5%，有保障。
zh..sip.s: 每年约{a}，投15年。扣除通胀后平均每年约5%，中途会遇到股灾。

zht..x: 公共公積金（PPF）年利率7.1%，免稅（利率每季調整，2025年都沒變），但錢要鎖15年。指數基金定期定額（SIP）則隨市場漲跌。
zht..ppf.s: 每年約{a}，存15年。扣除通膨後每年約2.5%，有保障。
zht..sip: 每月定期定額指數基金
zht..sip.s: 每年約{a}，投15年。扣除通膨後平均每年約5%，中途會遇到股災。

events.src: Gold: jewellery's making charges are not paid back on sale (about 10% or more: an ESTIMATE from jewellers' price lists); no new Sovereign Gold Bond tranche since February 2024 (Bajaj Broking, 2026).

opts.do: pay(a); mkLot('gold', { t: 'gold' }, 'trk.gold'); addLot('gold', .88 * a); lots.gold.tin += .12 * a; happy += 3
pay(a); mkLot('gold', { t: 'gold' }, 'trk.gold'); addLot('gold', .995 * a); lots.gold.tin += .005 * a

en..x: At Dhanteras and Akshaya Tritiya many families buy gold. Jewellery carries making charges, often 10% or more of the gold’s value, that you don’t get back when you sell; gold ETFs and coins avoid most of them. No new Sovereign Gold Bonds have been sold since February 2024.
en..none.s: Keep your savings as they are.

zh..x: 在财富节（Dhanteras）和阿卡夏三日节，很多家庭会买黄金。金饰要付工费，常常是金价的10%以上，卖的时候拿不回来；黄金ETF和金币几乎没有这笔费用。2024年2月以后就没有再发行新的主权黄金债券。

zht..x: 在財富節（Dhanteras）和阿卡夏三日節，很多家庭會買黃金。金飾要付工費，常常是金價的10%以上，賣的時候拿不回來；黃金ETF和金幣幾乎沒有這筆費用。2024年2月以後就沒有再發行新的主權黃金債券。

events.src: The Gulf: GCC countries sent 38% of India's remittances in 2023–24, down from 47% in 2016–17 (RBI survey, via Drishti IAS); registered recruiting agents may charge at most ₹30,000 (Emigration Rules, 1983): ≈ 0.33. Pay and housing multiples are ESTIMATES.

en..x: A recruiter offers a three-year contract in the UAE, Saudi Arabia or Qatar at about {a} a year, with housing provided. Gulf countries sent about 38% of the money Indians abroad sent home in 2023–24. A registered agent may charge you at most ₹30,000.

zh..x: 一家中介给你一份去阿联酋、沙特或卡塔尔的三年合约，年薪约{a}，包住宿。2023–24年度，印度海外侨民汇回国的钱约有38%来自海湾国家。合法中介最多只能收你30,000卢比。

zht..x: 一家中介給你一份去阿聯、沙烏地阿拉伯或卡達的三年合約，年薪約{a}，包住宿。2023–24年度，印度海外僑民匯回國的錢約有38%來自海灣國家。合法中介最多只能收你30,000盧比。

events.src: Chit funds: the foreman's commission is capped at 5% of the chit amount (Chit Funds Act, 1982, s. 21); members bid down the pot at monthly auctions. The discount for an early turn, the late-turn bonus and the default risk are ESTIMATES.

en..x: Colleagues run a chit fund: 20 members each pay in every month for 20 months, and each month one member takes the pot at an auction, bidding it down; the discount is shared among the rest. Registered chits follow the Chit Funds Act 1982, which caps the organiser’s commission at 5%.

zh..x: 同事办了一个标会：20个会员每月交钱，共20个月；每月由一名会员竞标拿走会钱，折让的部分分给其他人。合法登记的标会受1982年《标会法》管理，会首佣金最多5%。

zht..x: 同事辦了一個標會：20個會員每月交錢，共20個月；每月由一名會員競標拿走會錢，折讓的部分分給其他人。合法登記的標會受1982年《標會法》管理，會首佣金最多5%。

events.src: Health cover: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY gives ₹5 lakh a year of free hospital cover per family to about 55 crore people, and from Sep 2024 to everyone aged 70+ (PIB, Sep 2024). Private family-floater premiums (about ₹20,000 a year ≈ 0.22) and the shares of bills covered are ESTIMATES.

en..x: Private family health insurance costs roughly ₹15,000–25,000 a year. Under Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY, poorer families get free hospital cover of ₹5 lakh a year, and since 2024 so does everyone aged 70 or more.
en..buy.h: It pays about 70% of your medical bills.
en..pmjay.h: It pays about 45% of your medical bills.
en..no: Your family isn’t eligible for PM-JAY.

zh..x: 私人家庭医疗保险每年约15,000到25,000卢比。在国家健康保障计划（Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY）下，较贫困的家庭每年有50万卢比的免费住院保障，从2024年起，70岁以上的人也都享有。

zht..x: 私人家庭醫療保險每年約15,000到25,000盧比。在國家健康保障計畫（Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY）下，較貧困的家庭每年有50萬盧比的免費住院保障，從2024年起，70歲以上的人也都享有。

events.src: Monsoon floods: the southwest monsoon (June–September) brings most of India's rain (India Meteorological Department); the 2018 Kerala floods needed about ₹31,000 crore to rebuild (UN/World Bank Post Disaster Needs Assessment). The chance that a flood or storm reaches you comes from EM-DAT (people affected a year, 2000–2024: js/data.js); premiums, damage and preparation costs are ESTIMATES.

en..x: The southwest monsoon brings most of India’s rain between June and September, and heavy downpours flood parts of your city in many years. Home insurance that covers floods is cheap, but few households buy it.

zh..x: 西南季风在6月到9月带来印度大部分的雨量，很多年的大雨都会淹没你城市的部分地区。有水灾保障的房屋保险很便宜，但很少家庭买。

zht..x: 西南季風在6月到9月帶來印度大部分的雨量，很多年的大雨都會淹沒你城市的部分地區。有水災保障的房屋保險很便宜，但很少家庭買。

events.src: School: private unaided schools must keep 25% of entry-level seats for children from weaker sections, free, by lottery (Right to Education Act 2009, s. 12(1)(c)). Fees and the lottery odds are ESTIMATES.

opts.do: T('in_rte', { kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.schoolFees') }); rec('in_rte', a, 12); happy += 1; kidWin(.3, .7)

later.rte: if (roll('rte') < .35) { log(M('log.rteWin'), 'good'); kidWin(.3, .7); } else { log(M('log.rteNo'), ''); kidWin(.15, .8); }

en..x: Under the Right to Education Act (2009), private schools must keep 25% of their entry seats free for children from poorer families, filled by lottery. Private school fees vary widely; government schools are free.
en..private.s: About {a} a year for 12 years. Happiness +1.
en..private.h: A better chance of a scholarship later.
en..rte.s: If you don’t win the lottery, your child goes to a government school.
en..rte.h: About a 1 in 3 chance of a seat.
en..no: Your family earns too much for these seats.
en..govt.h: A smaller chance of a scholarship later.

zh..x: 根据《受教育权利法》（2009年），私立学校必须把25%的入学名额免费留给较贫困家庭的孩子，以抽签分配。私立学校学费差别很大；公立学校免费。
zh..private.h: 以后拿奖学金的机会较大。
zh..rte.s: 没抽中的话，孩子就读公立学校。
zh..rte.h: 大约三分之一的机会抽中。
zh..no: 你家收入太高，不能申请这些名额。
zh..govt.h: 以后拿奖学金的机会较小。

zht..x: 根據《受教育權利法》（2009年），私立學校必須把25%的入學名額免費留給較貧困家庭的孩子，以抽籤分配。私立學校學費差別很大；公立學校免費。
zht..private.h: 以後拿獎學金的機會較大。
zht..rte.s: 沒抽中的話，孩子就讀公立學校。
zht..rte.h: 大約三分之一的機會抽中。
zht..no: 你家收入太高，不能申請這些名額。
zht..govt.h: 以後拿獎學金的機會較小。

events.src: Weddings: Indian weddings are often the biggest expense a family makes, and many lower-income families borrow for them; giving or taking dowry is illegal under the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961. A ₹5 lakh wedding ≈ 5.4, ₹1.5 lakh ≈ 1.6 and a court marriage with a small reception (₹20,000) ≈ 0.2 of the game’s typical wage. Amounts are an ESTIMATE.

en..x: You and your partner want to marry. Both families are already talking about guests, venues and gifts, and you have made it clear there will be no dowry.
en..grand: A grand wedding over three days
en..grand.s: About {a} in all, mostly from your parents.{b}
en..court: A court marriage and a small reception

zh..x: 你和伴侣想结婚。两边家人已经在讨论宾客、场地和礼物，你也表明了不收不给嫁妆。
zh..grand.s: 总共大约{a}，大部分爸妈出。{b}

zht..x: 你和伴侶想結婚。兩邊家人已經在討論賓客、場地和禮物，你也表明了不收不給嫁妝。
zht..grand.s: 總共大約{a}，大部分爸媽出。{b}

events.src: Saving: monthly SIPs into mutual funds passed 9 crore accounts in 2025 (AMFI); traditional LIC endowment policies, often sold to young earners, have returned about 4–6% a year (financial press analyses), roughly nothing after India’s inflation of about 5%, and lapse with losses if you stop paying. Equity funds have averaged more over the long run with big swings. Amounts and rates are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: yearly('in_lic', {amt: .1 * base, until: age + 20}, {rate: 0, lock: age + 20}, 'trk.in_lic')

en..x: An uncle who sells LIC policies offers you an endowment plan. A friend says a monthly SIP in an index fund is better.
en..sip: A SIP in an index fund
en..sip.h: Stocks have grown well above inflation over the long run, with big falls along the way.
en..lic.s: About {a} a year for 20 years, guaranteed.
en..lic.h: Endowment policies have barely kept up with inflation.

zh..x: 做LIC保险的叔叔推荐你买储蓄型保单。朋友说每月定投指数基金更好。
zh..sip.h: 长期来看股票涨幅远超通胀，但中间会大跌。
zh..lic.h: 储蓄型保单的回报勉强跟上通胀。

zht..x: 做LIC保險的叔叔推薦你買儲蓄型保單。朋友說每月定期定額買指數基金更好。
zht..sip.h: 長期來看股票漲幅遠超通膨，但中間會大跌。
zht..lic.h: 儲蓄型保單的報酬勉強跟上通膨。

events.src: National Pension System: an extra income-tax deduction of up to ₹50,000 a year under Section 80CCD(1B) (old tax regime); the money is invested and locked until 60, when 60% can be withdrawn tax-free (PFRDA; Income Tax Act). ₹50,000 ≈ 0.54 of the game’s typical wage. Tax saved, taken as 20%, is an ESTIMATE.

en..x: Your tax bill keeps growing. Paying ₹50,000 a year into the National Pension System gives an extra tax deduction.
en..yes.h: The tax saved adds about a fifth, and it is invested.

zh..x: 你的税越缴越多。每年存₹50,000到国家养老金计划，可以额外扣税。
zh..yes.h: 省下的税大约多两成，而且会拿去投资。

zht..x: 你的稅越繳越多。每年存₹50,000到國家退休金計畫，可以額外扣稅。
zht..yes.h: 省下的稅大約多兩成，而且會拿去投資。

events.src: Joint families: many Indian couples live with the husband’s or wife’s parents, sharing costs and childcare (National Family Health Survey NFHS-5, 2019–21, household structure). Rent savings and effects on relationships are an ESTIMATE.

en..x: Your parents have a big house and want you both to live with them, as a joint family.
en..joint.s: Almost no rent, shared meals and help with children.
en..joint.h: Happiness −2: less privacy, some strain with your partner.
en..own.s: Your own rent, your own rules.

zh..x: 爸妈家很大，希望你们俩搬回来，一大家子住在一起。
zh..joint.s: 几乎不用房租，一起吃饭，孩子也有人帮忙带。
zh..joint.h: 幸福感 −2：隐私少了，跟伴侣有点摩擦。

zht..x: 爸媽家很大，希望你們倆搬回來，一大家子住在一起。
zht..joint.s: 幾乎不用房租，一起吃飯，孩子也有人幫忙帶。
zht..joint.h: 幸福感 −2：隱私少了，跟伴侶有點摩擦。

events.src: Civil Services Examination: about 10–13 lakh people apply each year for roughly 1,000 posts (UPSC annual reports, 2023–2024), a success rate near 0.1%; many prepare for years with coaching in Delhi costing ₹1.5–2 lakh (coaching fee pages, 2025). ₹2 lakh ≈ 2.2 of the game’s typical wage. The 3% chance here (for serious candidates) and the pay effect are an ESTIMATE.

later.in_upsc: if (roll('in_upsc' + x.n) < .03) { bump('in_ias', 1.3, M('trk.in_ias')); layM = (layM || 1) * .1; happy += 8; log(M('log.in_upscOk'), 'good') } else { log(M('log.in_upscNo'), 'bad'); if (!x.n) next('in_upsc2', 0, {}) }

en..x: Your parents dream of you joining the civil service. That means quitting your job to prepare full-time in Delhi for the UPSC exam.
en..prep: Quit and prepare for two years
en..prep.s: About {a} in coaching and living costs, and no pay.
en..prep.h: Happiness −3. Only a tiny share pass; those who do get a secure, respected career.
en.trk.in_upscP: Two years preparing for the exam
en.log.in_upscOk: You passed the civil services exam. Your family is overjoyed.
en.log.in_upscNo: You did not make the final list this year.

zh..x: 爸妈梦想你考上公务员。这表示要辞职去德里全职准备UPSC考试。
zh..prep.s: 补习和生活费大约{a}，还没有收入。
zh..prep.h: 幸福感 −3。考上的极少；考上了就是稳定又受人尊敬的职业。
zh.log.in_upscOk: 你考上公务员了，全家欣喜若狂。
zh.log.in_upscNo: 你今年没能进入最终名单。

zht..x: 爸媽夢想你考上公務員。這表示要辭職去德里全職準備UPSC考試。
zht..prep.s: 補習和生活費大約{a}，還沒有收入。
zht..prep.h: 幸福感 −3。考上的極少；考上了就是穩定又受人尊敬的職業。
zht.log.in_upscOk: 你考上公務員了，全家欣喜若狂。
zht.log.in_upscNo: 你今年沒能進入最終名單。

events.src: Many candidates make several attempts (up to six for general candidates, UPSC rules). Odds are an ESTIMATE.

en..x: You missed the final list. Friends from your coaching class are trying again.
en..again.s: About {a} and another year without pay.
en..again.h: Happiness −3. The odds stay very long.
en..stop: Go back to a private job
en..stop.h: Happiness −2: letting go of the dream.

zh..x: 你没进最终名单。补习班的朋友都要再考一次。

zht..x: 你沒進最終名單。補習班的朋友都要再考一次。

events.src: Ayushman Vay Vandana: since late 2024 every Indian aged 70 and over can get free hospital cover of ₹5 lakh a year under AB PM-JAY, whatever their income (National Health Authority; over 9.6 million cards issued by end-2025). The 60% cut in bills used here is an ESTIMATE.

en..x: Your grandson shows you how to apply for the Ayushman Vay Vandana card: free hospital cover for everyone over 70.
en..enrol.s: Free, with your Aadhaar and a phone.
en..enrol.h: Most hospital bills are covered from now on.

zh..x: 孙子教你申请Ayushman Vay Vandana卡：70岁以上的人都有免费住院保障。
zh..enrol.h: 以后大部分住院费都有保障。

zht..x: 孫子教你申請Ayushman Vay Vandana卡：70歲以上的人都有免費住院保障。
zht..enrol.h: 以後大部分住院費都有保障。

events.src: Borrowing in an emergency: gold loans from banks and NBFCs cost about 9–18% a year under RBI rules on loan-to-value (RBI, 2024–25), while informal moneylenders often charge 36% a year or more (RBI and NABARD surveys). ₹50,000 ≈ 0.54 of the game’s typical wage. Costs are an ESTIMATE.

en..x: A relative needs an operation and the family must find {a} this week.
en..gold: Pledge the family gold for a loan
en..gold.s: A bank gold loan, repaid over five years.
en..gold.h: About 9–18% a year: cheaper than most other quick loans.
en..family: Ask the wider family to chip in

zh..x: 有亲戚要开刀，家里这个星期得凑出{a}。
zh..gold: 拿家里的金饰去抵押贷款
zh..gold.s: 银行黄金抵押贷款，五年还清。
zh..gold.h: 年利率大约9–18%：比大部分急用贷款便宜。
zh..lender.s: 今天就拿到现金，不用文件。

zht..x: 有親戚要開刀，家裡這個星期得湊出{a}。
zht..gold: 拿家裡的金飾去抵押貸款
zht..gold.s: 銀行黃金抵押貸款，五年還清。
zht..gold.h: 年利率大約9–18%：比大部分急用貸款便宜。
zht..lender.s: 今天就拿到現金，不用文件。

events.src: Land: plots in new layouts are a popular investment, but land and property disputes make up about two-thirds of civil cases in Indian courts (DAKSH, Access to Justice Survey, 2016), and unclear titles are common. Price growth and dispute odds are an ESTIMATE.

en..x: A broker is selling plots in a new layout on the edge of the city. “Land never loses value,” he says.
en..plot.h: Land near growing cities has risen faster than inflation, but titles are sometimes disputed.
en..fund.h: Rises and falls with the stock market.

zh..x: 有个中介在卖城郊新规划区的地块。他说：“土地永远不会贬值。”
zh..plot.h: 城市周边的地涨得比通胀快，但产权有时会有纠纷。

zht..x: 有個仲介在賣城郊新規劃區的土地。他說：「土地永遠不會貶值。」
zht..plot.h: 城市周邊的地漲得比通膨快，但產權有時會有糾紛。

events.src: Land disputes often take many years in Indian courts (DAKSH, 2016; National Judicial Data Grid). Outcomes are an ESTIMATE.

en..x: A family has turned up with papers saying your plot, worth about {a}, was never the seller’s to sell.
en..court.s: About {b} in legal fees, and years of hearings.
en..court.h: Happiness −3. A bit over half keep their land.
en.trk.in_court: Legal fees for a land dispute

zh..x: 有一家人拿着文件出现，说你那块值大约{a}的地，卖家根本无权卖。
zh..court.s: 律师费大约{b}，还要开好几年庭。
zh..court.h: 幸福感 −3。一半多一点能保住土地。

zht..x: 有一家人拿著文件出現，說你那塊值大約{a}的地，賣家根本無權賣。

events.src: “Digital arrest” scams: fraudsters pose as police or CBI officers on video calls and demand money; Indians reported losing ₹1,935 crore in 2024 across 1.24 lakh cases (Ministry of Home Affairs, Rajya Sabha reply, Mar 2025). There is no such thing as a digital arrest; victims should call the 1930 helpline (I4C). Amounts are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: pay(a); const t = T('in_arr', {kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.in_arr')}); t.spent += a; t.g += a; happy -= 5

en..x: A man in uniform on a video call says your Aadhaar was used in a crime. You are under “digital arrest” unless you transfer {a} for “verification”.
en..pay.s: They say it will be returned.
en..pay.h: Real police never ask for money on a video call.
en..hang.h: There is no such thing as a digital arrest.

zh..x: 视频电话里一个穿制服的人说你的Aadhaar被用来犯罪，你被“数字逮捕”了，除非转{a}去“核实”。
zh..pay.h: 真正的警察绝不会在视频电话里要钱。
zh..hang.h: 根本没有“数字逮捕”这回事。

zht..x: 視訊電話裡一個穿制服的人說你的Aadhaar被用來犯罪，你被「數位逮捕」了，除非轉{a}去「查核」。
zht..pay.h: 真正的警察絕不會在視訊電話裡要錢。
zht..hang.h: 根本沒有「數位逮捕」這回事。

events.src: Futures and options: 93% of more than 1 crore individual F&O traders lost money between FY22 and FY24, an average of about ₹2 lakh each including costs, and over 75% of loss-makers kept trading (SEBI study, 23 Sep 2024). The odds and amounts here are an ESTIMATE based on it.

opts.do: pay(a); if (roll('in_fno') < .07) cash += 2 * a; else happy -= 2

en..x: A finance influencer says he makes a month’s salary every week trading options. Opening an account on the app takes five minutes.
en..trade.h: Nine in ten individual traders lose money.
en..index.h: Grows with the market over the long run.

zh..x: 一个理财网红说他每周靠炒期权赚一个月工资。在App上开户只要五分钟。

zht..x: 一個理財網紅說他每週靠炒選擇權賺一個月薪水。在App上開戶只要五分鐘。

events.src: Over 75% of loss-making F&O traders kept trading the next year (SEBI study, Sep 2024). Odds are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: pay(a); habit += .01; T('habit', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.habitSpend')}); if (roll('in_fno2') < .07) cash += 2 * a; else happy -= 3

en..x: Your options account is down. A new strategy video promises to win it all back.
en..more.h: Most traders who chase losses lose more.

zh..x: 你的期权账户亏了。有个新策略视频说能全部赢回来。
zh..more.h: 追亏损的人大多亏得更多。

zht..x: 你的選擇權帳戶虧了。有個新策略影片說能全部贏回來。
zht..more.h: 追虧損的人大多虧得更多。
